title: How Many Minions to STEAL the Moon?
summary: Despicable Me theme on a Fairy-Stockfish editor board: Tony's king 'Gru' plus N Minions (each moves one square in any direction, like a non-royal king) vs Fairy-Stockfish's king 'Vector' and queen 'the Moon'. With 1 minion he can only hold a draw-ish fortress (board resets ~3:01); he jumps to 3 minions, forces Vector to give up the Moon (~7:28) and mates with Gru + minion (~7:58).
rules: Player (White): king (Gru) + N Minions. Opponent (Black): king (Vector) + queen (the Moon) only.
Minion moves/captures one square in any direction (commoner, non-royal: can't be 'checked').
Win by capturing the Moon then checkmating Vector (i.e. normal checkmate).
N increases when a game can't be won: video went 1 minion -> 3 minions (two added at once).
win_condition: Checkmate Vector (Black king); won with 3 minions.
